notes.title: Termination Notice
notes.notes:
Hello, this is NINEVR.

We are pleased to announce that the CrossingMan, which was scheduled to end January 5 2020, has ended early Oct 25 2019.

Thank you for using CrossingMan, and we'll be back again with better content.

Thank you.

notes.title: Crossing Man Termination Notice
notes.notes:
Hello, this is NINEVR. 
From Jun 12, 2018, CrossingMan was serviced by STEAM, will close its service as of January 5, 2020.
Thank you for using CrossingMan, and we'll be back again with better content. 
Thank you.

notes.title: Crossing Man Update 18.10.08
notes.notes:
Update #1

1. We've found that some users struggled with walking on the rope because of the space restriction.
So we updated it to allow you to move using the touchpad even on the rope.

2. There were people who felt the frustrated at just being chased. Now you can equip your guns and fight your enemies.

3. Other minor bug have been fixed.
